description: Dynamic Island-style notch overlay for Windows with media controls, calendar, battery, webcam, volume and brightness HUDs, file staging, and plugins.
notes: Uses the official standalone WinNotch.exe release asset. The upstream release workflow publishes it with dotnet publish as a self-contained single-file win-x64 application; Scoop does not run WinNotch-*-Setup.exe.

WinNotch's in-app updater is left unchanged. When the user chooses to install an update, it downloads and runs the vendor's Setup.exe, which can install/update WinNotch outside this Scoop-managed copy.
